original_test_intent: Create a valid Device SDR repository reservation for the verified sensor device/LUN and prove its token encoding, session ownership and concurrency behavior without changing SDR records.
original_method: Preserve the exact Sensor/Event request `ipmitool raw 0x04 0x22` through an approved in-band path and parse the complete reservation response.
manual_activity: Owner validates the device/LUN, reservation width/byte order and concurrency policy once; the transient coordination request needs no per-run human approval.
required_inputs: Reservation ID width and byte order
safety_requirements: Do not treat reservation as exclusive access
Do not reuse a token across target, LUN or session
Reject zero/invalid/malformed token per approved schema
Do not blindly retry after cancellation
Do not read or mutate SDR records in this case
agent_execution_scope: Capture completion and exact response bytes
Bind token to target/LUN/session and timestamp
Close session or let token expire per policy
engineer_actions: Approve token schema and lifetime policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek incorrectly says a single stock command cannot express the operation; Master already gives the complete zero-payload raw request. Its caution about missing expected response remains valid.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected `ipmitool raw 0x04 0x22` for the verified device/LUN context, then validate completion, exact response length and reservation-ID byte order.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original request has no payload and is preserved exactly with attended time 10 and machine time 5.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Issue one reservation in a named session, decode the returned token and audit lifetime/concurrency without performing the downstream repository read or any record mutation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic response and session acceptance in the Review layer while leaving Master untouched.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A valid reservation proves protocol coordination only; it does not establish Get Device SDR content or traversal PASS.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Creating a new reservation can invalidate a competing reservation on some implementations; a token alone does not guarantee exclusive access.

project_override_considerations: A vendor library is equivalent only if it exposes the raw reservation result, target/LUN/session binding and cancellation behavior. An opaque downstream read that hides token creation leaves this command coverage unverified.
expected_evidence: Raw reservation response and decoded ID
Proof no SDR, sensor, BMC, chassis or log state was mutated

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master contains a complete raw request but only a no-error criterion and destructive generic log clearing. DeepSeek contradicts the source by calling the request unexpressible. Review keeps the request and adds the missing token/session oracle.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The command, purpose and bounded protocol state are explicit. Target/LUN and token semantics are routine project inputs; malformed responses can fail closed.

review_improvement: Corrects executability, validates the actual reservation token and prevents cross-session reuse or false exclusivity claims.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Device SDR reservation is a transient coordination token whose correctness depends on response length, byte order and session scope. Because creating it does not intentionally modify records and any ambiguity can stop before downstream reads, the case is safely automatable after schema confirmation.
